maintenanceNote: VERIFY BEFORE RELYING ON A DOLLAR FIGURE. These are list rates captured on the pricingVersion
date. They change, and they do not apply to every deployment:
- Amazon Bedrock and Google Vertex AI are partner-operated with their own pricing.
- Enterprise agreements, committed-use discounts and Priority Tier all differ.
- Batch API requests are 50% of these rates.
Cache write rates follow the standard multipliers (5-minute TTL = 1.25x input, 1-hour TTL = 2x
input) and cache reads are 0.1x input, except where a model publishes a different read rate.
